purpose: First bounded KODEX collage corpus assembled from the 16 semantic control references.

truth.rule: Reference-only records contribute mechanics and direction, never copied pixels. Creator-owned canon still requires an explicit public-asset derivative record before shipping.

layers.interaction: Pointer proximity reveals routes; keyboard focus exposes the same node labels; heart remains optional.
layers.fallback: Static SVG map with semantic links and no forced path.

layers.interaction: Observer position bends a bounded particle field; telemetry reflects actual scene state.
acceptance: poster shown when canvas is unavailable

layers.interaction: Core, ring, field and signal layers compose according to node state.
layers.fallback: Static SVG glyph sheet with textual state label.
acceptance: every line has a declared function

layers.interaction: Media fragments expand into provenance cards; audio controls exist only when playable media exists.
layers.fallback: Linear document list with thumbnails, captions and source links.
acceptance: external layouts are recomposed, not copied

layers.interaction: Real graph categories drive radial sectors; an authorized mask may resolve into an observer portrait.
layers.fallback: Accessible nested list and static SVG overview.
acceptance: all numbers map to real data

layers.interaction: Scroll-free time scrub reveals accumulated layers and reversible circulation.
layers.fallback: Static layered section with legend and metaphor label.

layers.interaction: A reviewed original or licensed specimen responds to focus with anatomy, origin and cultural context.
layers.fallback: Optimized WebP with caption, provenance and non-motion description.
acceptance: cultural guardian has context and authorization status

layers.interaction: One scene-level motion owner; Motion.dev is permitted only for bounded drag/spring behavior that Anime.js does not own.
layers.fallback: CSS state changes and prefers-reduced-motion mode.
acceptance: no duplicate animation runtimes per behavior

handoffs.KOD-10: Use this as the 16-record control set and choose public-safe derivatives separately from OCIN / BOOK.
handoffs.KOD-37: Return only local iMac implementations that satisfy one of these layer jobs and are absent from GitHub/Drive.
handoffs.KOD-54: Track each layer by evidence fields; keep unknown progress UNMEASURED.
